metadata.scope: Legislative result years exposed by the website menu at retrieval: 2016, 2021, 2026. Other election types and earlier years absent from that menu are not included.
metadata.date_basis: Election dates and labels are reproduced from the source pages.

2016.scope: All result filter combinations exposed by this archived legislative election page; other election types are not included.
2016.number_normalization: Vote-count groups in the DOM were reversed to restore their numeric order; original strings are retained.
2016.percent_units: Percentage points: 38.08 means 38.08%, not a fraction.
2016.null_semantics: Unknown, unavailable, or inapplicable; never automatically zero.
2016.demographic_derivations: Reported labels are preserved. Zero/baseline bars are reconstructed only when one seat would produce more than two pixels. A single missing category can be recovered from the seat total and other categories. Unlabelled national regional-list categories may be recovered from all 12 regional-constituency counts. value_status identifies each derivation. Counts are inferred, not directly published counts.

chart_party_aliases.method: unique unmatched winning list with matching seat count

2016.seat_derivations: 2016 counts are uniquely reconstructed from displayed chart percentages and total seats, and checked against constituency vote tables and winners. 2021 counts are from the seat table.

metadata.join_rules: Use election_id with source geographic IDs and party_id. Query IDs are globally unique and prefixed with year. Parties are listed separately for each election to preserve year-specific names and abbreviations.
metadata.ballot_types: 2016: local and national; 2021 and 2026: local and regional. Do not add votes across ballot types to estimate voters.
metadata.overlapping_views: seat_results, turnout and demographics contain overlapping query summaries. Filter by query_id before aggregating.
metadata.number_normalization: Vote-count groups are reversed from source RTL DOM strings; votes_source_text preserves the source representation.
metadata.collection_method: Rendered browser tables and SVG chart labels, using observed dropdown options. Direct HTTP requests received 403; no direct API data is claimed.
